snippet.description:
🔗 Website: kickbacks.ai

The loading spinner in Claude Code might be some of the most highly watched real estate in the software engineering world right now. While developers sit and wait for Anthropic's agentic AI to finish compiling code, engineer Andrew McCalip realized those valuable eyeballs were completely unmonetized.

Enter "Kickbacks," a brilliant browser and VS Code extension that completely redefines how developers can monetize their workflow. Instead of looking at a traditional loading icon, users are shown targeted, real-time sponsored text lines from tech companies bidding for developer attention. Because engineering teams and "vibe coders" spend hours watching these agents work, the ad space is incredibly high-value for advertisers looking to target technical builders.

The defining feature of this project is the monetization model. The creator is giving 50% of all ad revenue directly back to the developers who install the extension. By simply syncing a Google account and letting the extension run in the background of VS Code, Cursor, or your terminal CLI, you accumulate a share of the impressions and clicks. Early estimates suggest this can easily cover the baseline subscription costs of running advanced AI tools.

Check the pinned comment below for the direct link to get started and claim your share of the revenue.

Passive Income Guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1StftY30mbMtaegaM4VSlP7U4iD2GHPn6xUyOY99vWsQ/edit?usp=sharing

Passive income is probably the most misunderstood idea on the internet.

People see someone making money while sleeping and think, "Nice. So I just need a laptop, Wi-Fi and an unhealthy amount of confidence."

Unfortunately, that's not how it works.

Before you can make money passively, you usually have to work very actively.

In this video, I break down a practical framework for figuring out what you should sell, who you should sell it to, how to reach them, and how to actually make the sale.

No "make ₹1 lakh per day from your phone" nonsense.

No magical AI business that prints money while you sit on a beach.

Just business fundamentals. We'll cover:

• SWIOT Analysis — How to understand your strengths, weaknesses, interests, opportunities and what you can realistically build around
• What to sell — How to choose a product, service, digital product or offer people might actually pay for
• Who to sell to — Why trying to sell to everyone usually means selling to nobody
• How to reach them — Content, audience building, distribution and getting attention in a world where everyone is screaming online
• How to sell — Turning attention into customers without sounding like a WhatsApp forward
• Bonus — The extra insight that can change how you think about building income

The truth is simple:

Passive income is usually the result of building an asset first.

A business.
An audience.
A product.
A system.
A skill that can eventually work without you being involved every single minute.

But before the income becomes passive, you cannot be.

If you're between 16 and 30 and constantly searching "best passive income ideas" while having absolutely no idea where to start, this video is for you.

Watch this before buying another ₹499 course that promises financial freedom by Tuesday.
